some components over here
on this flex ribbon.

Here I've drawn maybe
a couple of capacitors

mechanical reinforcement

of course fatigue these solder joints
or fracture those solder joints.

Now this stiffener section
here has another purpose,
and that is to allow us to, for example,
affix this section
of the flex ribbon to an enclosure.

One of the benefits of
this stiffener region

hole through this entire stack.

to then mechanically fix
this section of the design
to, for example, an enclosure.

a rigid layer stack.

copper layer right here,

another copper layer right here.
